fact: RGPH-4 was conducted 1 to 31 July 2025 across the national territory; preliminary results, acted by presidential decree of 6 March 2026, give 17,521,167 residents including foreigners.

A PN-RAVEC official cites results of the fourth general population census (RGPH-4) giving a resident population of 17,521,167, of which 3,407,327 in Conakry; no enumeration date is given, so the document's published date is used.
The Ministry of Plan, through INS, published preliminary results of RGPH-4 on 25 February 2026 (population 17,521,167), and the Prime Minister called the census completed; enumeration date not given.

On 30 October 2025 the Minister launched the post-enumeration survey of RGPH-4, which assesses the coverage of the census's main enumeration already carried out; the enumeration date is not given, so the document date is used.
